CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2663 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head a487ee67b5c310276f5652c4180033893b9ce217. Bus nonce: 4d4fea90c317f3379e6cc1c822c4721a. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin a487ee67b5c310276f5652c4180033893b9ce217`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge a487ee67b5c310276f5652c4180033893b9ce217` or `Fix review: blocked a487ee67b5c310276f5652c4180033893b9ce217 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 4d4fea90c317f3379e6cc1c822c4721a`; then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else goes under `## Evidence`; the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2663 a487ee67b5c310276f5652c4180033893b9ce217") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2663-4d4fea90`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2663, a roster batch (branch fix/audit-r10-roster-pr3), head a487ee67b5c310276f5652c4180033893b9ce217. It lands 10 append-carry commits from handoff/audit-r10-roster onto main 4c31eb16, the same shape as PRs #2655 and #2661. The only files are dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json and the delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2663.md. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head. Your ev/ MUST contain ev/HEAD.txt holding the full 40-hex head, or the relay refuses the verdict.

Verify:
(1) Three-dot diff `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...HEAD`: only the roster and the delivery row. Any other file blocks the PR.
(2) Use jq over both rosters. Each of the 9 changed groups gains only appended carries, with no stage, brief or `after` change. Each carry's text matches its roster_edit commit message source, and each cites a real source: the #2632 review (R10-LIVESTATE, R10-FLY-SUITE-ENV-FLAKES), the RCA raise-gate grammar (R10-POLICY-LINT-FAMILY), triage P-N (R10-FLOW-JIDOKA), triage P-O (R10-FLY-RELAY-REVIEW-FF), and the others the commits name. Any SHA, file or line a carry cites must exist at origin/main or on the ref it names.
(3) Null control: nothing main wrote to the roster since the merge base is lost. Group count before and after is 169, and no group is removed.
(4) `node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs` on the roster reports 0 errors. Record the scoped-gate MODE line. Read CI with one bulk check-runs call. The merge-tree against origin/main is clean, VERSION is untouched, and the commits carry no footers.
Rules: PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1; spare the GitHub API; no Claude footers.
